# Brian Marshall — Business Systems Architect

> I find exactly where your business is losing money, map the full operational blueprint, and build the infrastructure that fixes it. For owner-operated businesses with real revenue.

## Who this is for

Owner-operated businesses generating real revenue that have outgrown how they currently operate. Not for early-stage idea validation or coach-only offer packaging (see coach resources below).

## Funnel

1. **Free 15-minute qualifying call** — https://brianmarshall.dev/calendar — No pitch. Diagnose where the business breaks. Clarity either way.
2. **AOF Master Audit — $1,497** — https://brianmarshall.dev/aof#purchase — Live audit session. Fully custom 13-block Master Audit: pipelines, workflows, automations, AI opportunities, integrations, priorities, line-item build pricing. Developer-ready. You keep the document. The $1,497 is credited in full toward implementation when you move forward within 30 days of receiving your deliverable.
3. **Build** — CRM, automation, AI, integrations, funnels scoped from the audit.

## AOF Master Audit — 13 blocks

Phases: Diagnose (blocks 1–6), Design (7–9), Decide (10–13).

Covers: business context, revenue motion, pipeline, communication, constraint/failure analysis, AI and automation leverage, tech stack and data flow, economics, goals, priority system, pricing and scope, execution summary.

Stress-test scenarios include: lead volume doubles, owner unavailable, ad spend scales, busy season, key employee quits, price increases.

## What gets built (implementation)

- CRM and pipeline architecture
- Workflow and automation
- AI implementation (assist, automate, replace)
- Websites and funnels
- Integrations and data flow
- Speed-to-lead infrastructure
